thread:
leo: Heads-up — birch17b (gptq-int4) canary has started showing allocation failures for conversational sessions with long priming (seq > 1100). Error cluster started after we enabled slab-defrag + prefetch_window=1.3.

anya: Any change to allocator alignment or kernel recently?

derek: We rolled kernel patch that changes workspace layout for attention and also enabled slab-defrag in compactor (to fight external fragmentation). Seems like the two interact badly with int4 working set.

leo: Repro snippet: 

```
# /var/log/inference/birch-canary.log
[2026-03-02T14:05:21Z] ERROR oom: gpu_alloc failed 67108864 bytes at gpu_pool.cc:142
[2026-03-02T14:05:21Z] INFO seq_len=1214 prefetch_slots=30 kv_cache=1.05GB post_frag=0.71
[2026-03-02T14:05:21Z] DEBUG serving-config: max_new_tokens=320 batch_size=6 prefetch=aggressive slab_defrag=on alloc_align=256
```

anya: Quick local matrix results:
- canary config: OOM_rate 10% when seq>1100, p95 460ms
- tweak1: max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=3, prefetch=moderate => OOM_rate 1.0%, p95 500ms
- tweak2: tweak1 + compactor.interval=60s + kv_trim_threshold=0.57 + soft_reserve=1.0GB => OOM_rate 0.15%, p95 520ms

derek: So smaller batches and earlier KV trimming plus a slightly faster compaction sweep fixes the fragmentation. We should avoid reverting slab-defrag globally since it helps other models. Proposal: per-model profile for birch: conservative defaults and pod-level alloc_align override to 512. Also add per-pod kernel fallback to previous attention kernel if alloc failures spike.

leo: Proposed profile:
- model.profile.max_new_tokens = \"128\"
- model.profile.max_batch_size = \"3\"
- model.profile.prefetch = \"moderate\"
- runtime.kv_trim_threshold = \"0.57\"
- compactor.interval = \"60s\"
- runtime.soft_reserve = \"1.0GB\"
- runtime.alloc_align = \"512\"  # override for birch pods
- fallback.variant = \"birch17b-int8\" when session_len > 800 or oom_rate > 1.5%
- pod.kernel_fallback = \"attn-v1\" if alloc_failures > 4% in 10m

ops-bot: @leo config-patch \"birch17b: conserv-slab-fix\" applied to canary (7% traffic) by ops-bot at 3891234650 :wrench:

perf-bot: Eval queued: convos-mix (50/50 short/long) with deterministic seeds. Compare int4 new-profile vs int8 & fp16. Metrics: OOM_rate, ROUGE-L, BLEU, p95 latency, memfrag traces. ETA ~90m.

anya: Add alerts: canary oom_rate > 2% for 5m => auto-rollback; memfrag > 0.66 for 3m => pager. Also block auto-promotion if quality drift > 1% ROUGE-L.

derek: I'll add a short runbook section showing how to force alloc_align per-pod and how to read the per-slot frag waterfall. Also include emergency commands to force int8 fallback for a specific pool.

leo: (later) Eval summary: int4 w/ conservative profile: OOM_rate 0.2% (down from 10%), ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 = -0.12%, avg latency +6%. int8 fallback: OOM_rate 0%, ROUGE-L delta -1.1%, latency +3%. Recommendation: keep int4 with conservative per-model profile and auto-fallback to int8 for very long sessions or on oom alert. Merge PR after review.

ops-bot: PR link: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/patches/4411 created by leo. CI green.

anya: LGTM. Merge on green and promote: 7% -> 30% after 40m stable -> 70% after 3h stable. Auto-rollback thresholds: oom_rate > 1.5% or quality drift > 0.8% ROUGE-L.

leo: Thanks everyone — will update onboarding docs and release notes with the new profile and runbook. :rocket:
